contracts.authority: Dart SDK archive (storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive): the SDK archive of each release the extension pins; Flutter SDK releases (storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases): the archive of each release the extension pins
contracts.reason: Installs the Dart or Flutter SDK a package's constraint admits when the machine has none: downloads the archive of the release the extension pins and checks it against the pinned SHA-256. The formats belong to the Dart and Flutter release processes, so no Putnami provider declaration can generate this client.
